findings.title: Do not treat skipped cleanup as confirmed
findings.basis: killOwnTree returns skipped:no-pid/root-exited/error and Windows snapshot-failed without incomplete. !cleanup.incomplete is therefore true for unconfirmed cleanup. With an exited root the new assertion may pass while descendant state was not confirmed.
findings.requestedFix: Reject cleanup.skipped. On darwin require incomplete===false and scope===observed-tree. Preserve platform-specific successful return shapes for Windows/Linux. Include signalCode in already-exited Promise precheck.

resolvedFindings.resolution: All8 cleanup sites reject skipped, and darwin explicitly requires incomplete===false with observed-tree scope. Already-exited promise checks include signalCode. Actual runtime confirmation remains separate.
